description: Butter Chicken, or Murgh Makhani, is a classic Indian dish known for its rich, creamy tomato-based sauce and succulent marinated chicken. This beloved curry offers a delightful balance of sweet, tangy, and mildly spicy flavors, making it a favorite across the globe. Prepare to savor an authentic taste of India right in your own kitchen with this satisfying recipe.

ingredients.item: Boneless, skinless chicken thighs or breast

ingredients.notes: for marinade, adds color and mild heat

instructions.title: Marinate the Chicken
instructions.text: In a large bowl, combine chicken pieces with yogurt, ginger garlic paste, lemon juice, Kashmiri red chili powder, turmeric powder, garam masala, and a pinch of salt. Mix well to coat the chicken evenly. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes, or up to 4 hours for best flavor.

instructions.title: Cook the Marinated Chicken
instructions.text: Heat 1 tablespoon of butter in a large pan or skillet over medium-high heat. Add the marinated chicken pieces in a single layer, ensuring not to overcrowd the pan. Cook in batches if necessary. Sear the chicken for 3-4 minutes per side until lightly browned and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside.

instructions.title: Prepare the Base Sauce
instructions.text: In the same pan, add another 2 tablespoons of butter. Once melted, add the finely chopped onion and sauté until softened and translucent, about 5-7 minutes. Add the remaining ginger garlic paste and cook for another minute until fragrant.

instructions.title: Build the Flavorful Curry
instructions.text: Stir in the tomato puree, Kashmiri red chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, and a pinch of salt. Cook this mixture for 8-10 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the sauce thickens and the oil separates from the sides. This step is crucial for developing deep flavors.

instructions.title: Simmer and Finish the Sauce
instructions.text: Add the cooked chicken back into the pan with the tomato sauce. Stir in the sugar and crushed fenugreek leaves (Kasuri Methi). Pour in about 1/4 cup of water if the sauce is too thick. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook for 5-7 minutes, allowing the flavors to meld.

instructions.title: Add Cream and Garnish
instructions.text: Remove the pan from heat. Stir in the heavy cream and the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter until fully incorporated and the sauce is wonderfully creamy. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed. Garnish generously with fresh chopped cilantro before serving.

tips: For an extra smooth sauce, blend the tomato base after step 4 until completely smooth before adding the chicken back in.
Do not skip the Kasuri Methi (dried fenugreek leaves); it provides the signature aroma and slightly bitter, sweet, and tangy taste essential to authentic Butter Chicken.
Serve Butter Chicken hot with warm naan bread, roti, or steamed basmati rice to soak up all the delicious, creamy sauce.
